title: Restore readable Ghost Ship canvas while preserving horror lighting

phases.title: Make the bundled Ghost Ship readable by default without removing sparse dynamic lighting
Repair already-created managed Ghost Ship scenes that inherited the nearly-black lighting preset
Publish the Ghost Ship visibility repair as module 0.3.1

finalChecks.name: Ghost Ship readable preset
finalChecks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); if(!s.includes('darknessLevel: 0.58')) throw new Error('readable darkness preset missing'); if(!s.includes('darknessLevelLock: false')) throw new Error('darkness lock still enabled');"

finalChecks.name: Manifest version
finalChecks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.1') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.1');"
